title: Deeper/broader peer artifact-lineage and ACIS-route readiness refresh
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Separate ACadRust releases, mutable source, and application-pinned codec/kernel revisions
Refresh the maturity and evidence ceiling of open-source ACIS semantic routes
Turn the LibreDWG AC1027 AcDs-loss reproducer into a scratch-only composed-gate control
Preserve fast local implementation gates and existing external qualification boundaries

method.kind: Read current primary project release, source, issue, package documentation, and local plan pages
method.limitations: Mutable repository pages and issue reports are discovery evidence, not runtime qualification. LibreDWG issue #1411 was not reproduced; its real R2018 drawing is confidential and unavailable. No ACIS profile, native consumer result, or local defect was inferred. The repository-pinned ODA v5.4.1 specification remains authoritative for DWG layout.

sources.revision: Release/source/docs pages reviewed 2026-10-18; latest GitHub release v0.6.4 at 8d5c46d; mutable Cargo.toml says 0.6.5; issue #134 open
sources.observed: The published release, mutable source package version, and current issue state are not interchangeable. Issue #134 describes a version-specific AC1032 MLeader-context truncated-stream regression against 0.6.4. The test suite includes fabricated SAB framing and same-codec round-trip controls; those are useful writer/parser regressions but not independent solid-semantic evidence.

sources.revision: Mutable application manifest and kernel README reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: OpenCADStudio aliases a separately pinned opencadcodec revision 5d4f11a as acadrust and pins OpenCADKernel a60f18f with acis/offset features. Current kernel documentation describes an ACIS lift/lower layer but also labels the project early and states most operations are not yet written. Neither application tessellation nor README capability prose alone proves complete, valid B-rep semantics.

sources.revision: Issue page reviewed 2026-10-18; report pins LibreDWG 0.14.8593 at 8a1ae764 on Linux x86-64
sources.observed: The reporter constructs an AC1032 DXF REGION with a 5,489-byte SAB payload through ezdxf, converts DXF-to-DWG-to-DXF, and reports silent loss of the AcDs payload. A separate real R2018 drawing is confidential and not attached. The report suggests a scratch-only, identity-keyed interoperability control but was not independently reproduced.

cq-acis remains a limited bare SAT/SAB parser and CadQuery/OCCT conversion route; OpenSolid is a downstream STEP/kernel candidate without direct DWG, DXF, SAT, or SAB input. Neither can validate the outer entity-to-AcDs association, and they do not constitute two independent ACIS kernels.

assessment.planImpact: Clarifies exact artifact lineage for optional peer runs and refines the existing AC1027 composed AcDs/ACIS evidence gate to use a scratch-generated analytic solid with per-object identity, exact carrier bytes, owner/key association, geometry validity, and consumer acceptance scored independently. Existing local queue and fast validation cadence are unchanged.

implementationReadyChecks: Record exact release/tag or commit, repository URL, package version, features, OS/toolchain, operation/direction/version, hashes, diagnostics, and parser/kernel lineage for every peer run.
Do not transfer results among standalone ACadRust, mutable main, OpenCADStudio's opencadcodec fork, or its pinned kernel revision.

At the existing composed gate, generate an asymmetric analytic solid in memory or scratch storage and compare source handle/type/owner, modeler flag, AcDs record/key, exact payload length/hash, B-rep validity/closure, units/transforms, and native result separately.
Do not commit generated DWG/DXF/SAT/SAB/STEP outputs or download the confidential issue drawing.
Keep peer/native checks out of the routine fast slice loop; record unavailable or profile-incompatible cells as NOT_RUN/NOT_QUALIFIED and continue local implementation.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL; this research does not meet their platform or independent semantic evidence requirements.
